entries.text: The work was commissioned by or for the sitters for the great hall of the Kloveniersdoelen, the arquebusiers’ civic guard headquarters in Amsterdam.
The work was first recorded at the Kloveniersdoelen in 1653, described as a painting by Rembrandt from 1642.

entries.owner: Small Council of War Chamber, Town Hall, Amsterdam
entries.text: In 1715, the work was transferred from the Kloveniersdoelen to the Small Council of War Chamber in the Town Hall on Dam Square.
entries.basis: Archival resolution of 23 May 1715; Dyserinck 1890, p. 245

entries.text: In 1808, the work was transferred to Roos’s house, the Trippenhuis, at 29 Kloveniersburgwal.
The City of Amsterdam lent the work to the museum from 1808.
